description: List a website's, app's, agent's, or skill's releases, newest first. The list includes each activated release's version, state, commit, and creation time. The service's release pointer marks the current release. To roll back a website, app, or agent, call rollback_service with a listed version; get_source with release reads an earlier release's files first. A skill's release version is the version get_skill reports, and get_skill with release returns that release. Requires connecting a Valet account.

limit.description: How far back the history reaches, counted in releases from the newest. Raise it to find an older version to pass to rollback_service or get_source as release.

name.description: The website's, app's, agent's, or skill's name, as list_services shows it: the one whose releases to list.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: list_releases

kind.description: Kind of the service: site, app, agent, or skill.

name.description: Name of the website, app, agent, or skill.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

releases.description: The service's activated releases, newest first, up to limit.

active.description: True when the service's current release pointer names this release.

commit.description: The Git commit the release was built from. Absent for a release that predates commits.

created_at.description: When the release was created, as an RFC 3339 time.

state.description: The release's state. Every listed release has activated, so this reads active.

version.description: The release's version. Pass it as release to rollback_service, get_source, or, for a skill, get_skill.

total.description: The number of activated releases, including those beyond limit.

title: List releases
